outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: GET is the shared SvelteKit request-handler function exported for GET requests. It merges private and platform environment values, checks rate limiting, then returns a non-nullish limiter result or delegates the request to HubApiController.handle; this file adds no GET-specific behavior.
